prompt: Last year a chess club had only junior members and senior members. This year the number of junior members is 50 percent greater than last year, the number of senior members is 25 percent less than last year, and the total number of members is 20 percent greater than last year. What fraction of this year's members are juniors?

A ship sails straight toward a vertical cliff at a steady 10 meters per second. At one moment it sounds its horn, and the echo from the cliff is heard on the ship exactly 6 seconds later. Sound travels at 340 meters per second. How many meters from the cliff was the ship at the moment it sounded its horn?

A river flows at a steady 3 kilometers per hour. A rower who rows at 12 kilometers per hour in still water is rowing upstream, and she keeps the same rowing effort throughout. As she passes under a bridge, her hat falls into the water and floats downstream with the current. She notices 30 minutes later, immediately turns around, and rows downstream until she reaches her hat. How many kilometers downstream of the bridge is the hat when she reaches it? (Ignore the time taken to turn around.)

A printer prints 20 pages per minute. Each time it has printed another 80 pages of a job, it stops for 3 minutes to cool down and then continues printing at the same rate. Starting from the first page, how many minutes does the printer take to print a 520-page job?

A sum of money was going to be shared among Ana, Ben and Cara in the ratio 1 : 3 : 4. Before it was paid out, the plan was changed, and the whole sum was shared among them in the ratio 2 : 3 : 4 instead. As a result, Cara received $12 less than she would have received under the first plan. How many dollars did Ben receive?

ABCDE is a convex pentagon. Its five diagonals AC, CE, EB, BD and DA are drawn, forming a five-pointed star whose points are A, B, C, D and E. The angle of the star at each point is the angle between the two diagonals drawn from that point: angle CAD at A, angle DBE at B, angle ECA at C, angle ADB at D and angle BEC at E. The angle of the star at A measures 25 degrees and the angle at B measures 29 degrees. The angles of the star at C, D and E are equal to each other. What is the measure, in degrees, of the angle of the star at C?

Point P lies inside rectangle ABCD, whose vertices are labeled in order around the rectangle. The distance from P to A is 6, the distance from P to B is 24, and the distance from P to C is 32. What is the distance from P to D?

In triangle ABC, angle C is a right angle. Point D is on side AB so that segment CD is perpendicular to AB. The perimeter of triangle ACD is 150, and the perimeter of triangle BCD is 360. What is the length of AB?
Point P lies inside a circle of radius 25, at a distance of 15 from the center of the circle. How many chords of the circle pass through P and have a length that is a whole number?

Seven points are placed on a circle, and every pair of the points is joined by a chord. The points are placed so that no three of the chords pass through the same point inside the circle. Into how many regions do the chords divide the inside of the circle?
Points A, B, C and D lie on a circle in that order as you go around it, and segment AC is a diameter of the circle. AC = 25, AB = 7 and AD = 15. What is the area of quadrilateral ABCD?

In triangle ABC, point D lies on side AB and point E lies on side AC. Segments BE and CD meet at point P. The area of triangle BPD is 6, the area of triangle BPC is 12, and the area of triangle CPE is 8. What is the area of quadrilateral ADPE?

A rectangular floor 20 feet long and 8 feet wide is covered with square tiles, each 1 foot on a side, laid in straight rows and columns. A straight line is drawn from one corner of the floor to the opposite corner. Through how many of the tiles does the line pass? (A tile is counted only if the line passes through its interior.)
A convex polygon has interior angles whose measures are all whole numbers of degrees, and no two of its interior angles are equal. What is the greatest number of sides the polygon can have?

A rectangular room is 26 feet long, 10 feet wide and 10 feet high, so its two end walls are 10-foot-by-10-foot squares 26 feet apart. A spider sits on one end wall, on the vertical line halfway between the two side walls, 1 foot below the ceiling. A fly sits on the opposite end wall, on that wall's vertical center line, 1 foot above the floor. The spider crawls to the fly, staying on the walls, ceiling and floor of the room at all times. What is the length, in feet, of the shortest path the spider can take?

A solid cube has edges 4 centimeters long. Let P and Q be two opposite corners of the cube, so that the segment PQ passes through the center of the cube. Of the cube's 12 edges, exactly 6 have neither P nor Q as an endpoint. A single flat cut passes through the midpoints of these 6 edges, and the cut face is a hexagon whose vertices are those six midpoints. What is the area, in square centimeters, of the hexagon?

A rectangular tank is 30 inches tall, and its flat bottom measures 24 inches by 27 inches. It contains water to a depth of 5 inches. A solid metal cube with edges 18 inches long is lowered into the tank and rests flat on the bottom, and no water spills out. How deep, in inches, is the water now?
In the coordinate plane, a pentagon has vertices at (0, 0), (6, 0), (8, 4), (4, 8) and (0, 5), listed in order around the pentagon. What is the area of the pentagon, in square units?

A trapezoid has parallel sides of lengths 4 and 12. A segment parallel to these two sides, with its endpoints on the other two sides of the trapezoid, divides the trapezoid into two regions of equal area. What is the length of this segment?
In the coordinate plane, O is the origin, A is the point (5, 12) and B is the point (9, 0). What is the slope of the line through O that bisects angle AOB?

Seven people, including Ann, Bea and Cal, sit down at random in the seven equally spaced chairs around a round table, one person to a chair, with every seating equally likely. What is the probability that Ann sits next to neither Bea nor Cal?
How many four-digit positive integers are written using exactly two different digits? (For example, 3133 and 2552 are counted, but 5555 and 1231 are not.)

Eight lamps stand in a row, and each lamp is either on or off. A run is a stretch of one or more neighboring lamps that are all on and that cannot be made longer, because each end of the stretch is next to a lamp that is off or is at the end of the row. (For example, on, on, off, on, off, off, on, on has 3 runs.) In how many different settings of the eight lamps are there exactly 2 runs?

A box holds 8 cards. Each card is colored on both sides: 4 cards are red on both sides, 1 card is blue on both sides, and 3 cards are red on one side and blue on the other. One card is taken from the box at random and laid flat on a table, with each of its two sides equally likely to be the side facing up. The side facing up is red. What is the probability that the other side of this card is also red?

Ana and Ben plan to meet at a library. Each of them arrives at a random time between 3:00 p.m. and 4:00 p.m., with every moment in that hour equally likely, and the two arrival times are independent of each other. If Ana arrives first, she waits 10 minutes for Ben and then leaves. If Ben arrives first, he waits 40 minutes for Ana and then leaves. (Either of them may wait past 4:00 p.m.) What is the probability that Ana and Ben meet?

Die A is an ordinary fair six-sided die numbered 1 through 6. Die B is a fair six-sided die whose faces are numbered 1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 2. A fair coin is tossed to choose one of the two dice, and the chosen die is then rolled twice. What is the probability that the two rolls show the same number?
Five different integers are added in pairs in every possible way, giving ten sums. The ten sums are 33, 36, 51, 55, 66, 70, 73, 85, 88 and 103. What is the median of the five integers?

A large rectangle is divided into 24 equal small squares arranged in 4 rows and 6 columns, by lines drawn parallel to its sides. How many rectangles of any size, including squares and including the large rectangle itself, have all four of their sides lying along these lines (the drawn lines or the sides of the large rectangle)?

In a sequence of numbers, the first term is 9, and each term after the second term is the average (arithmetic mean) of all the terms that come before it. The 9th term of the sequence is 26. What is the second term?

Lena walks along the streets of a grid from corner P to corner Q, which is 5 blocks east and 4 blocks north of P. On every block she walks either east or north, so every route is 9 blocks long. A turn is any place where she switches from walking east to walking north, or from walking north to walking east. How many different routes from P to Q have exactly 4 turns?

A three-digit positive integer is called a valley number if its middle digit is less than each of its other two digits. For example, 503, 717 and 948 are valley numbers, but 455 and 132 are not. How many three-digit positive integers are valley numbers?

A square is divided into four equal smaller squares, two on the top and two on the bottom. Each small square is to be painted one of 5 different colors, and not every color has to be used. Two small squares that share a side must be painted different colors, but two small squares that touch only at a corner may be the same color. In how many different ways can the four small squares be painted? (Paintings that differ only by a rotation of the large square count as different.)

Twenty-five teams play a tournament in which every team plays every other team exactly once, and every game has a winner (there are no ties). What is the greatest possible number of teams that could each win at least 18 games?

Five teams play a tournament in which every team plays every other team exactly once. Every game has a winner, each of the two teams in a game is equally likely to win it, and the results of different games are independent. What is the probability that no team wins all of its games and no team loses all of its games?

Ann, Ben and Cal take turns throwing a ball at a target, always in the order Ann, Ben, Cal, Ann, Ben, Cal, and so on. Each throw hits the target with probability 1/3, independently of all other throws. The first person to hit the target wins, and the throwing then stops. What is the probability that Ben wins?
A function f is defined for every integer x, and f(x) + f(x + 1) = x^2 for every integer x. If f(0) = 1, what is the value of f(100) ?

A sequence of four positive integers is geometric (each term after the first equals the term before it multiplied by the same number r) and increasing. Its first term is 64, and its last term is less than 1000. How many different values of r are possible?
The numbers x and y satisfy x^2 + 5y = 24 and y^2 + 5x = 24, and x is not equal to y. What is the value of x^2 + y^2 ?
The positive numbers x and y satisfy x > y and x^2 + y^2 = 4xy. What is the value of (x + y)/(x - y) ?

The only prime factors of the positive integer n are 2 and 3. Multiplying n by 2 gives a number that has exactly 3 more positive divisors than n has, and multiplying n by 3 gives a number that has exactly 6 more positive divisors than n has. How many positive divisors does 12n have?
For how many positive integers n is (n^2 + 47)/(n + 5) an integer?

For how many whole numbers n from 1 to 200, inclusive, is the sum of all the positive divisors of n an odd number? (For example, the positive divisors of 6 are 1, 2, 3 and 6, and their sum, 12, is even.)
For each whole number k from 1 to 100, let r(k) be the remainder when k^2 is divided by 7. For example, r(3) = 2, because 3^2 = 9 = 7 + 2. What is the value of r(1) + r(2) + r(3) + ... + r(100)?
A two-digit whole number is divided by the sum of its own two digits. For example, 47 divided by 4 + 7 = 11 gives a quotient of 4 and a remainder of 3. What is the greatest possible remainder?
What is the least positive integer n for which the sum 1 + 2 + 3 + ... + n is a multiple of 72?
N is the smallest positive integer that is divisible by 1125 and is written using only the digits 1 and 0 (each digit of N is either 1 or 0). How many digits does N have?

For a three-digit positive integer N whose units digit is not 0, let R be the three-digit number formed by writing the digits of N in reverse order. (For example, if N = 418, then R = 814.) Consider every such N for which N + R = 1252. What is the sum of all these values of N?
For how many positive integers less than 10,000 is the sum of the digits equal to the product of the digits? (For example, 22 is one of them, because 2 + 2 = 2 x 2.)
Each of the 359 fractions 1/360, 2/360, 3/360, ..., 359/360 is written in lowest terms. How many of them then have a denominator of 30?

A board shows the two numbers 91 and 143. A move consists of choosing two different numbers on the board and writing their positive difference on the board, as long as that difference is not already on the board. Moves are made, in any order, until no move is possible. How many numbers are on the board at the end?
What is the greatest integer k for which 2^k is a factor of 5^16 - 1 ?
